title: If you have your phone text size magnified, it is annoying!
body: If you have your phone text size magnified, like many of us with bad eyes do, you can't access the slider to open the tip! I have to adjust my text size, read it, then put my text size back! It's super annoying, and every time I say I'm deleting the app!  But. The tips are usually pretty good!  Please fix this! I should be able to read it without all this hassle! I guarantee many others are inconvenienced as well. (I saw one review where they said it was a glitch. Lol Not realizing it was their larger text size... Regardless this shouldn't happen! No other app has an issue with it!
author: VegasHawkeye

title: No luck with VoiceOver screen reader
body: I only experimented with this app for a few minutes, but I didn’t find much I could activate. At one point there was a slide to unlock item. I could not slide it with Double Tap and hold gesture. I did try to determine the place on the screen of that item then shut voiceover down touch and slide and bring voiceover up again. I had different content, but the only thing I found was referring to an app called pneumo-. My friend was looking at something called wisey.app, but what I saw didn’t sound like the content she was seeing. I didn’t wait any extended time to see what happened if I got a push notification. probably going to delete the app. gave it three stars because I really couldn’t evaluate the content. my only comment is that I think this could be useful to blind people with ADHD who use voiceover, so would encourage exploration of making it accessible. from reviews, I too, would like to see the ability to access the list of tips or whatever else is in the program without having to wait for them to be presented as push notifications.

title: Love the insight!
body:
The Lifehack suggestions must have been developed by actual ADHD Adults or even children (though many don’t actually believe the BEAUTIFUL ADHD Brain has a higher IQ than most) because we are always thinking. Overthinking, getting caught up in “hyperfocusing” too often in what we like not what we have intended to accomplish.

These LifeHacks though I wish they could be PDF’d are great for me. When I read one daily, which is where the ONLY issues comes for me with the app, I would like 1 to start the day and 1 immediately at the beginning of each day. Instead of having to wait a certain amount of hours.

Numo is too overwhelming! I read one and think to myself, “exactly” or “that’s just what I had been thinking, that might make it easier for me!”

title: Good idea, but flawed
body: It’s a cute app, some of the tips are useful and some very corny. However, it has one major flaw. The notifications are scheduled at the same time every day, which means it easily becomes rutinary noise in the sea of notifications some of us with adhd live in. If you don’t check them daily, you’ll miss on the tip/trick. It’s penalizing you for not opening the app daily while also telling you it’s ok to not perform every day. Quite the irony giving the audience!

title: Simple.. Yet quite effective!
body: Of all things, who knew just a tiny bit of information such as 1 simple affirmation a day would make such an impact on how I view my disability, myself, and success. 1 simple ADHD life hack a day, that if just one time proved effective over what I’ve been doing then that’s huge to me! Let alone multiples. Now to keep myself focused enough to come back and rehearse them lol. I’m grateful for this app and the support it’s provided me. I love the thought of keeping it simple and quick as to not overload our already overloaded minds.
author: Divine Dreamer

title: Lifesaver & Confidence Booster!
body:
Unlike Neurotypical folks, I need to see/read/hear something MANY times before it becomes a ‘ Go To’ or becomes an Action to develop a Habit around. I ‘BELIEVE’ that by saving info in an ADHD File I my Cloud, Printing out a copy & pining it to my “L👀K Center” or even flagging a page in a book will cause me to “Re•Visit” these GREAT IDEAS when I’m ready to write them in my Habit Tracker section of my BuJo…. WRONG…..

THIS APP is the ONLY WAY THAT WORKS! It is almost Gamified in that it ‘Pops Up’ each day all fresh & new! However, I’ve now developed a routine with a digital list & the “Latest” hack as an entry…. I then review this list at the end of the month and add on to my Habit-Tracker for the next month.

THIS APP HAS CHANGED MY LIFE! More than ADDitude Website/Magazine App or any other Specialized App for Neurodivergent folks like me!

I’d also like to add that I’m 57 years old…. You CAN teach an old dog NEW TRICKS!!!  

THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR THIS APP!!!!

title: Really basic/unhelpful tips with bad grammar and upkeep
body:
This app was recommended to me and I’ve always been stumped why. I check it out of curiosity every day, because it’s easy enough, and have had it for several months now. I’ve not really found any of the tips in this time helpful or even thoughtful - in fact, they’re very basic. Some of them border on jibberish, as the grammar is pretty bad. For the last 1-2 weeks, the app hasn’t been updated with a new tip - it’s the same one every day.

I do like the idea of this app. Checking in to see a tip of the day, and being able to save any ones you like as a “favorite” is a really cool idea. I just think the execution is so sorely lacking that it’s not worth downloading or using.
